messages.subject: Error in `[.data.frame`(site.cov.data, , var.names) :   undefined columns selected
parts:
Hello all,

I am having issues with my model predictions for the static occupancy models (I am quite new to using occupancy models). All my models have run and I am able to get model averaged abundance estimates but when I go to run the predictions, this is where it does not work properly. I am trying to see if forest type (primary or secondary) as well as fruit biomass (a continuous predictor) predicts local animal abundance at my 42 camera trap stations (21 in each forest type).
The first part of the code works (where I create newData1) but the predsmod part (the 2nd line of code) is where I am having trouble. I am using unmarkedFramePcount with zero inflated poisson mixture.

newData1<-data.frame(fruit=seq(min(fruit.mass.z),max(fruit.mass.z),,50),forest=1,
    camhours=mean(na.omit(camhours.z)),vis=mean(na.omit(vis.z)))
predsmod<-data.frame(modavgpred(cand.set=Cands,modnames=Modnames,newdata=newData1,type="response",parm.type='lambda'))
pred1<-data.frame(fruit.sd=newData1[,1],fruit=((newData1[,1]*fruit.sd)+fruit.mean),N_forest1=predsmod$mod.avg.pred, #prediction 1
    SE=predsmod$uncond.se,lowCI=predsmod$mod.avg.pred-1.96*predsmod$uncond.se,hiCI=predsmod$mod.avg.pred+1.96*predsmod$uncond.se)

The error message I get when I try to run the predsmod part is
Error in `[.data.frame`(site.cov.data, , var.names) :
  undefined columns selected

thanks in advance! Any ideas on where to look to fix this issue would be very much appreciated!

messages.subject: RE:[unmarked] Error in `[.data.frame`(site.cov.data, , var.names) : undefined columns selected
parts:
Hi Alys,

The error is from modavgpred( ) which is in package AICcmodavg. I made substantial changes to the package recently (version 2.0-1 on CRAN) and modavgpred is now renamed to modavgPred. Also make sure that your newData1 object is a data frame that includes all the explanatory variables that appear on lambda in your candidate model set. In other words, you need to supply a value for all these variables in your newData1 object.

Other changes to AICcmodavg include a set of new custom functions to do multimodel inference selection (aictabCustom, modavgCustom) for cases where the output is from external software (say from PRESENCE) and imported in R, where the user supplies log-Likelihood, K, beta estimates and SE's.

Hope it helps,

Marc
